title: test_ping_endpoint_returns_pong
description: Verify that the POST /grpc/EngineService/Ping endpoint returns a 200 status with a PingResponse containing pong, confirming the health check functionality.

title: test_start_run_with_valid_graph_accepts_run
description: Test the POST /grpc/EngineService/StartRun endpoint with a valid run_id and graph_json to ensure it returns a 200 response with accepted=true and initiates execution.

title: test_start_run_with_invalid_graph_rejects_run
description: Test the POST /grpc/EngineService/StartRun endpoint with an invalid graph_json to verify it returns a 200 response with accepted=false and an appropriate validation error message.

title: test_start_run_with_missing_required_fields_rejects_run
description: Verify that POST /grpc/EngineService/StartRun with missing run_id or graph_json returns a 200 response with accepted=false and an error message indicating missing required fields.

title: test_get_run_status_returns_current_status
description: Test the POST /grpc/EngineService/GetRunStatus endpoint with a valid run_id to ensure it returns a 200 response with the current run status and current node information.

title: test_get_run_status_for_nonexistent_run_returns_404
description: Verify that POST /grpc/EngineService/GetRunStatus with a non-existent run_id returns a 404 response indicating the run was not found.

title: test_cancel_run_successful_cancellation
description: Test the POST /grpc/EngineService/CancelRun endpoint with a valid run_id to confirm it returns a 200 response indicating successful cancellation of the active run.

title: test_metrics_endpoint_returns_prometheus_metrics
description: Verify that the GET /metrics endpoint returns a 200 status with Prometheus metrics text representing engine health and runtime telemetry.
